explanation: Virgil modelled the Aeneid on Homer about seven centuries later. Dying in 19 BC with the poem unfinished, he asked for it to be burned, but Emperor Augustus refused.

claims.text: Homer's Odyssey was composed around 700 BC, in the late 8th or early 7th century BC.
Virgil wrote the Aeneid between 29 and 19 BC.
Virgil modelled the Aeneid on Homer's Iliad and Odyssey.
The Aeneid was written about seven centuries after the Odyssey.
Virgil died in 19 BC with the Aeneid unfinished and asked for it to be burned, but Augustus had it published.
